name: 15-font-variant-stretch
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 6px 0; line-height: 1.6; } .sc { font-variant: small-caps; } .st { font-stretch: condensed; } .lig { font-variant-ligatures: none; font-feature-settings: "liga" 0; }
html:
Small Caps 小大写 Abc 字宽观察

Condensed 窄体 字宽变化观察 ABC abc

Ligatures off: fi fl ffi 连字关闭
